{{Quote|Chief? Sorry to interrupt, Lieutenant.''"<br />"''What is it, Raban?''"<br />"''We've got a report of a fight between two passengers at the Galleria Shop.|Raban reports to Detien Kaileel|<ref name="ACPOV" />}}
'''Raban''' was a [[Security officer/Legends|security officer]] onboard the [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] under [[Chief of Security/Legends|Security Chief]] [[Detien Kaileel]]. He reported an incident to Kaileel regarding a fight between two passengers occurring in the [[Galleria Shop]].<ref name="ACPOV" />
